name: iniBuilds TriStar Airliner (L-1011)

flaps._comment: L-1011-family flap labels use 0, 4, 10, 22, 33, and 42. Flap and gear speed values are provisional compatibility values pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification. Normal takeoff: 4 or 10. Normal landing: 33 or 42 (42 = FULL for short/wet runways; 33 = normal). The iniBuilds FAQ confirms AoA mode auto-engages at Flaps 33.

engines._comment: 3 Rolls-Royce RB211 engines. 2 wing-pylon mounted, 1 centre-mounted via S-duct through fin. EPR-rated (not N1). The iniBuilds simulation uses a detailed EPR logic model.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only; no vendor-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

autopilot._comment: The documented AFCS key events use SimConnect, but this profile does not use generic AUTOPILOT MASTER or mode SimVars as AFCS-state readbacks. Keep those fields unavailable until a vendor-documented and independently verified source is available.

spoilers._comment: TriStar Direct Lift Control (DLC) uses spoiler panels during normal approach, so the generic SimConnect spoiler value can include DLC or roll-spoiler movement rather than only speedbrake-handle state. Keep spoiler UI/scoring state unavailable until a dedicated handle or autospoiler source is verified.

controls._comment: Official iniBuilds TriStar keybind FAQs publish SimConnect Event IDs for AFCS and lights. This profile preserves only AFCS toggle/off events that the current Flight Fabric control surface can represent safely. They remain profile-level controls and are not promoted into the trusted aircraft-specific adapter because no independent reliable AFCS effect readback exists. Selector inc/dec events, light events, and INI_* action LVAR references remain inactive until runtime support and in-simulator verification catch up.

autopilot._comment: These AFCS events are vendor-documented but not yet verified in-sim. Toggle-only events must not be mapped to on/off semantic requests.

meta.notes: iniBuilds TriStar Airliner for MSFS 2024. A dedicated monitoring-first page exposes an explicit standard-SimVar field set for AFCS selector windows, lights, configuration, engines, fuel, weight, and pressurization. Generic AP/mode booleans and spoiler state are excluded because they do not represent the required AFCS and speedbrake-handle semantics. Vendor-documented profile-level AFCS key events remain available while broad generic autopilot fallback stays blocked. Flap and gear speed values remain provisional pending vendor verification.

sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. The trusted TriStar adapter exposes only an explicit backend allowlist already normalized by Flight Fabric and activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: telemetry variables.

knownIssues: Flap and gear speed values are provisional and need redistributable public-source or vendor verification before promotion.

TriStar spoiler telemetry is suppressed because DLC uses spoiler panels during normal approach and generic SimConnect spoiler state can report DLC/roll spoiler deflection rather than actual speedbrake handle deployment.
Active AFCS control mappings are documented by official iniBuilds keybind FAQs but remain untested pending in-sim verification.
Generic SimConnect AP master/mode readback is suppressed because it can remain off while the custom TriStar AFCS is actually engaged.
The dedicated page is monitoring-only. Its 32 standard-SimVar fields require live TriStar verification; the four AFCS selector values are candidates and no AFCS engagement or mode state is claimed.
The dedicated page intentionally excludes generic spoiler/speedbrake state because DLC can move spoiler panels independently of speedbrake-handle intent.

The trusted aircraft-specific adapter exposes no write actions because no reliable independent AFCS effect readback is available. Existing source-backed profile-level AFCS key-event controls are preserved separately.

The profile intentionally maps only safe toggle/off AFCS events. Selector inc/dec events, VOR course inc/dec events, and INI_* action LVAR references from the official FAQ are documented but not active because the current semantic control surface expects absolute selector set writes or verified pulse semantics.
Official light key events are documented, but the current profile control service has no semantic light-control resolver. TriStar lights remain SimConnect telemetry/presentation only.
The cited vendor material does not define a complete TriStar custom telemetry interface, so the profile does not subscribe custom LVAR readbacks.
No RPN/H-event autothrottle action is active because Flight Fabric's current MSFS provider does not support html-event/H-event actions and no vendor-published production mapping has been verified.

_comment: iniBuilds TriStar Airliner for MSFS 2024. Classic Lockheed L-1011 tri-jet wide-body powered by three Rolls-Royce RB211 engines. Flap and gear speed values are provisional pending vendor verification. The monitoring-only adapter exposes an explicit standard-SimVar field set without generic AP/mode booleans, ambiguous spoiler state, vendor-specific telemetry routes, or aircraft-specific writes. Profile-level AFCS key events are sourced from official iniBuilds documentation.
